term: Hume second causal definition: customary mental transition
definition: MentalCause(a,b) requires succession and an appearance-to-thought transition. The transition parameter represents the customary psychological relation of VII.29, not a counterfactual, metaphysical necessity, or a proof of rational warrant.
note: Explicit analytical interface for issue #270. Source support and its limits are separately recorded in the linked source claims and docs/hume-regularity.md. Stronger metaphysical identifications require further argument.
